evaluation_improvement_plan_007.evidence: If any teacher has unsatisfactory performance in Domain 1 or 4, the teacher shall be placed on a Performance Improvement Plan. The Performance Improvement Plan shall be written by the teacher, primary evaluator, and an IEA representative or appropriate third party if requested. The teacher and primary evaluator shall complete the PIP by May 15th for implementation for the following school year unless an emergency or illness justifies a delay. If a teacher does not reach “Basic” performance at the completion of a one-year Performance Improvement Plan, the evaluator may recommend non-renewal of contract, completion of a second PIP, or reassignment to another of the teacher's areas of certification in which he or she has experience in the IPS system if such a vacancy exists.

evaluation_consequences_008.evidence: If any teacher's unsatisfactory performance is in Domain 2 or 3, the primary evaluator may recommend non-renewal of the contract. If a teacher does not reach “Basic” performance at the completion of a one-year Performance Improvement Plan, the evaluator may recommend non-renewal of contract, completion of a second PIP, or reassignment to another of the teacher's areas of certification in which he or she has experience in the IPS system if such a vacancy exists.
